apps.name: Photos Backup
apps.localizedDescription:
#### Added

* **Black Screen Mode** on Home and Activity for long backups. Keeps the app awake with a black background and dim backup counts that move around the screen once a minute.
* Tap anywhere to show backup details and controls, then use **Return to Black Screen** when you're done. Turn off **Show Status in Black Screen Mode** for a completely blank screen; the setting is saved for next time.
* **Tips for Long Backups** beside the mode button, with advice on power, Wi-Fi, heat, and keeping the app open.

#### Changed

* Added a fast offline protocol test suite that runs with `swift test`.
* Local development and CI now use the same offline simulator test script, with signing enabled for Keychain coverage and live Google tests excluded.
* Removed account and credential details from live-test logs.

#### Fixed

* Manual installation-feed updates now stay on this fork instead of switching back to upstream releases.

#### Notes

* Version 0.3.9, build 17.
* Black Screen Mode leaves the phone on and unlocked. Exiting restores normal auto-lock without stopping uploads. Screen brightness is unchanged, so lower it in Control Center if needed.
* An empty queue does not mean the whole photo library is backed up. The counts reflect the current account and the albums the app has scanned.
* 215 offline iOS tests passed on the iOS 26.5 Simulator, plus 8 standalone protocol tests. Live Google uploads and device background execution were not tested for this release.
* Install this fork's IPA through SideStore or AltStore. The upstream source will not install updates from this fork.
* GitHub Actions builds the release IPA from the tag and attaches its SHA-256 checksum.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/Mxlted/PhotosBackup/compare/0.3.8...0.3.9)
